findings.finding: Carried forward unchanged. Remaining residuals, accurately stated in the design note and acceptable for Jeff to sign off: (1) XDG_CACHE_HOME: under a sudo that drops it, setup (and slots.sh, which reads only ~/.cache) holds or checks locks no build takes; running VMs are still found by carrier, a build starting during setup is not. (2) slots.sh holds no lock through its reload; it is the documented debugging stand-in. An owner-planted FIFO blocks the user's flock child and so the script; self-inflicted and low.
findings.suggestion: Carry both residuals into the PR body's security note for acknowledgement at merge (FLOW-08). Take the root-owned setup gate later only if a user reports the XDG case.
